searchText: can we please not call it phase1.5 🤣 I named it that and no longer like it, but people know what it is... i usually just call it eth1+eth2 or the unification of Ethereum under eth2 consensus Phase 1.5 is a short way to describe a long and complex thing and it sounds. The next step in the evolution of this term would be Phase 1.x, likewise Eth1.5 became Eth1.x a couple of years ago. But that's gonna be terrible mess then. I like Phase 1.5 - it sounds incomplete. I'm scared about getting stuck there and never really pressing on to do Phase 2 properly. Everything we can do to communicate it as a stepping stone and not a terminus is good with me.
